title: Vehicle preventive-maintenance and inspection process — FY2017 grant evidence
summary: The FY2017 Section 5310 grant binder includes RTEC's Vehicle Maintenance Program and describes daily driver inspections, mileage capture, preventive-maintenance tracking, and electronic transmission of maintenance reports to RTEC computers.

claims.claim: Drivers were required to complete daily pre-trip and post-trip inspections, and vehicle mileage was recorded daily.

evidence.page_or_section: PDF page 93 / binder Preventive Maintenance Program and Forms

claims.claim: Preventive maintenance for RTEC vehicles was entered into a mobile data computer that sent report data to RTEC computers.
The Vehicle Maintenance Program states that drivers must check emergency exits before boarding passengers and that vehicle inspections are generally conducted as pre-trip inspections.

evidence.page_or_section: PDF pages 95-96 / Vehicle Maintenance Program introduction and inspections

trigger: Daily vehicle operation and scheduled preventive-maintenance interval.
systems: Historical mobile data computer / RTEC maintenance-report system
steps: Complete pre-trip vehicle inspection before service.
Track scheduled preventive-maintenance intervals and record completed maintenance.
Transmit/store maintenance report data in the RTEC maintenance system.
controls: Vehicle defects or unsafe conditions are to be reported immediately.
Emergency exits checked before boarding passengers.
Scheduled maintenance supported by recurring reports/forms.
unresolved_questions: What current software/system replaced the FY2017 mobile-data maintenance reporting setup?
What are the current preventive-maintenance mileage/time intervals?
Which current inspection forms supersede the FY2017 manual?

provenance.source_date_or_version: SFY2017; Vehicle Maintenance Program revised through 2016
